description: This file provides functions for managing bundled plugin build entries in a build system. It includes logic to read plugin configurations, identify source files, generate build artifacts, and determine runtime dependencies for plugins in the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Collects build entries for bundled plugins by reading plugin directories and their configurations.

methods.name: listBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Returns a mapping of plugin source entries to their file paths.

methods.name: listBundledPluginPackArtifacts
methods.description: Provides a list of all build artifact files generated for the plugins, like JSON and JS files.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Lists all runtime dependencies required by bundled plugins based on their package.json configurations.
